jobs.occupation: Associate Professor in ‘Experimental Nanooptics’.
jobs.description:
The Mads Clausen Institute, Center for Nano Optics (www.sdu.dk/nano-optics) invites applications for an Associate Professor position in ‘Experimental Nano-Optics’. The starting date is Feb 1st, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

The successful candidate is expected to conduct cutting-edge experimental research within nano-optics involving advanced optical characterization of localized and propagating strongly enhanced and confined electromagnetic excitations with the state-of-the-art amplitude and phase-resolved near-field microscope available (NeaSpec). The near-field characterization is expected to be complemented with other optical characterization techniques as well as with performing advanced electromagnetic modelling. The candidate should have documented teaching experience at both BSc and MSc levels along with the corresponding teaching portfolio.

The application material should include a detailed motivation and an outline of the research activities that are to be pursued. In their applications, applicants should highlight their ten most significant journal publications, detailing also their author contributions. Applicants who wish to be considered should provide a link to a fully-updated ResearcherID (www.researcherid.com). The application material should also include detailed accounts on supervision and teaching experience.

The prospective candidates should have a Ph.D. degree in physics, preferably within nano-optics, and documented research experience in the aforementioned experimental techniques. They are expected to have a notable international profile, strong record of research publications, and demonstrated exceptional potential to excel in scientific research. We expect the candidate to actively engage in the development of academic research, conducting vigorous fund raising activities, and educational environment at the Centre for Nano Optics.

The candidate is expected to teach and instruct both graduate and undergraduet students as well as supervise bachelor and master projects. Furthermore, the candicate is expected to contribute actively to young-researcher education through supervision of Ph.D. students and postdoctorial researchers. 

For further information about the position and research infrastructure as well as Centre for Nano Optics, contact Prof. Sergey I. Bozhevolnyi (seib@mci.sdu.dk).

Read more on: http://www.sdu.dk/en/stillinger

Contact information
For information about the Mads Clausen Institute, please see www.sdu.dk/en/mci. 

Further information about this position is available Prof. Sergey I. Bozhevolnyi (seib@mci.sdu.dk).

Please be aware that we will not accept any email applications, as all applications must be submitted through the SDU online recruitment system.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Application 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

• 
Research plan for the position in question (max. 2 pages). 
Upload in the field called "Project description". 

• 
Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, describing research, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, external funding etc.

• 
Verified copies of official Certificates/Diplomas (BSc, MSc and PhD) 

• 
List of publications with most relevant publications highlighted.

• 
Up to three names and emails of researchers, who can provide an informed reference letter at short notice (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included).

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration no.) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: 

Motivated application shall be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents shall be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files of max 50 MB per file).

The application deadline is November 1st, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

Read more and apply at https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in Veterinary Microbiology
jobs.description:
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
 University of Copenhagen

   

  We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated veterinary microbiologist for a 2-year part-time postdoc position starting around 1st January 2027. The new postdoc is expected to contribute to the scientific and teaching activities of the research group One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) within the section of Veterinary Clinical Microbiology. Additionally, the postdoc will be responsible for defined scientific and management activities within the project SOA36 - Designing best veterinary practices to reduce antimicrobial and antiparasitic use (BEST-VET), funded by the European Partnership on Animal Health and Welfare (EUPAHW). These responsibilities include supporting the project Chair in the day-to-day coordination and management of the consortium, as well as planning and conducting research aimed at reducing antimicrobial use in pigs through improved diagnostic and treatment protocols for key endemic bacterial diseases, and active involvement in the development of clinical guidelines for prudent antimicrobial use in pig medicine, with a particular focus on developing evidence-based guidelines using the GRADE approach. Through these activities, the postdoc will contribute to strengthening antimicrobial stewardship and promoting evidence-based best practices in veterinary medicine.

  Information on the department and the section can be found at: https://ivh.ku.dk/.

  Our research
 The postdoc will be part of the OHAR research group led by Prof. Luca Guardabassi. Our research is characterized by two focus areas:

   	
• Development of diagnostic tests and methods to reduce and rationalize antimicrobial use in animals. 	
• Optimization of veterinary antimicrobial use to minimize selection and spread of antimicrobial resistance.   For more information, please check the OHAR homepage One Health Antimicrobial Resistance (OHAR) – University of Copenhagen

  Your job
 You are a highly qualified veterinary microbiologist with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team. You will be required to be physically present in the laboratory to contribute to ongoing research projects and oversee experiments conducted by PhD, MSc, and BSc students. As part of the EU project BEST-VET, you will contribute to selected work packages and expert groups, including WP1 (Reduction of drug use in pigs), WP7 (Environmental impact of antimicrobial/antiparasitic drugs and phage therapy), Expert Group 1 (Phages and their environmental impact), Expert Group 3 (Standardization of sampling, metagenomics & analytical methods) and Expert Group 5 (Clinical guidance). You will be responsible for coordinating and following up on SOA36 activities related to these work packages and expert groups. You will also act as a key point of contact between the project management, work package leaders and expert groups. Your project management responsibilities will further include supporting the organisation of Management Board meetings, following up on project activities and deadlines, and maintaining the SOA36 SharePoint and associated project documentation. As part of the position, you will undertake a one-year training programme in evidence-based guideline development using the GRADE approach and subsequently contribute to the development of evidence-based clinical guidelines for veterinary medicine.

  Profile 
 We are seeking a highly qualified scientist with a strong track record of independent research in veterinary bacteriology and experience in international collaborative research project coordination, as well as in the supervision and teaching of veterinary and postgraduate students.

  Essential experience and skills:

   	
• A MSc degree in Veterinary Medicine 	
• A PhD in Veterinary Microbiology or a closely related field 	
• Previous postdoctoral experience 	
• Outstanding publication record in relation to career stage 	
• Excellent scientific writing and oral communication skills 	
• Experience in supervising PhD, MSc, and BSc students 	
• Experience in the coordination and management of collaborative research projects 	
• Experience with bacterial whole-genome sequencing and genomic data analysis 	
• Knowledge of key concepts in antimicrobial stewardship   Desirable experience and skills:

   	
• Research experience in antimicrobial resistance 	
• Experience in metagenomics 	
• Experience in routine bacteriological and mycological diagnostics 	
• Experience in preparing research proposals and applications for external funding   Place of employment
 The place of employment is at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories that are fully equipped to perform traditional and molecular microbiology, including omics.

  Terms of employment 
 The average weekly working hours are 37 per week.

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

  Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

  Questions
 For further information please contact Luca Guardabassi (lg@sund.ku.dk).

  Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

  Please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae 	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent) 	
• Research plan – description of current and future research plans 	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of 3 particularly relevant papers   After the expiry date or applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. 

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Application deadline: 15 October 2026, 23.59 CEST.

  Interviews are expected to be held in weeks 44-45 (26th October – 5th November 2026).

  The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, nationality, race, religion or sexual orientation. Appointment will be based on merit alone.

jobs.occupation: Sales Executive  - Ready to turn Software/ERP expertise into closed deals? Interform HQ Birkerød, DK or Remote
jobs.description:
The role

Interform builds InterformNG2, an Output Management platform that sits next to the ERP and handles the documents a business runs on: invoices, labels, delivery notes, e-invoicing. When output fails, shipments stop and invoices get rejected. Our customers buy certainty that this never happens.

You will sell InterformNG2 to new customers across Europe - with our core markets in the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux and the UK - typically manufacturing, logistics and distribution companies running ERPs such as Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or IBM i. You own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed agreement.

There is no BDR team here, but you are not starting from a blank sheet either. We identify the most relevant accounts together, backed by an AI-driven engine that tracks buying signals across our markets. Your job is what happens next: the outreach, the conversations, the proposals and the close.

What you will do

• 
Turn qualified target accounts into meetings, pipeline and closed deals across your European territory.

• 
Open doors through direct outreach and your own network of ERP consultants, partners and IT decision-makers.

• 
Run full sales cycles - qualification, demo coordination, proposal, negotiation, close - in close collaboration with the rest of the commercial team.

• 
Work with our partner ecosystem around Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i and other ERP platforms as a second route to market.

• 
Feed what you learn in the market back into how we position and price.

Who you are

• 
Driven. You show up every day ready to do your best, and you keep that standard through long sales cycles.

• 
Connected in the ERP ecosystem. Ecosystem knowledge is essential in this role: you know at least one major ERP ecosystem in real depth - the partners and implementation consultants in it, how they influence a deal and when to bring them in - and you bring a working network you can call on from day one.

• 
Self-starting. You plan your own work, execute without being chased, and deliver.

• 
Accountable. You own your number and you follow up - customers can trust that you are always a step ahead.

• 
At home in the ERP world. You have sold software or services into environments running Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i or comparable ERP platforms, and you speak the language of IT managers and operations directors.

• 
AI-forward. You already use AI in your daily sales work - research, preparation, follow-up - and want a company that works the same way.

• 
A closer. You have proven you can turn outreach into pipeline and pipeline into signed deals - not just manage inbound.

• 
Languages: fluent English is required. German, Danish or Dutch on top is a strong advantage - ideally you cover one of our core markets natively.

What we offer

• 
A place in a solid company: profitable, in strong growth, and with a large market still ahead of us.

• 
A product that is easy to stand behind: more than 4,500 installations worldwide, and customers who stay.

• 
A defined category - Output Management - where we compete on depth, not noise.

• 
Short decision paths and direct access to management.

• 
An AI-driven account-based marketing engine that shows you which companies are in the market - so your time goes to conversations, not list-building.

• 
A competitive package that rewards what you close.

About Interform A/S

Interform has built Output Management software since 1987 from our headquarters in Birkerød, Denmark. Our platform, InterformNG2, works with any ERP, any format and any environment - customers change or upgrade their ERP and keep their output running. Our first customer from 1987 is still with us today. Our customer base is international - companies across the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux, the UK and further afield - and our own team works across borders in the same way, with colleagues based in Denmark and Germany. We are a profitable, solidly run company in strong growth, and investment backing supports continued development of the platform.

Practical details

• 
Location: our office in Birkerød, Denmark, or remote from anywhere in our European markets - we already have employees working outside Denmark, so a distributed setup is nothing new to us.

• 
Travel: limited. Most sales work runs remotely, with occasional customer, partner and event travel.

• 
Reports to: our Chief Commercial Officer - you will work alongside the rest of the commercial team.

• 
Start: as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

How to apply

Upload your CV and cover letter, including the deals you are most proud of.

Birkerød I Remote

jobs.occupation: Embedded Linux Engineer and Consultant
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about Embedded Linux and eager to make a real impact across industries? Join Prevas as an Embedded Linux Engineer and Consultant, helping our clients navigate technology transitions, ensure product security, and build new embedded solutions for a safer, smarter world. Whether you come from a consultancy background or have experience as a technical leader in product development, this could be your next step.

About the Role: Embedded Linux Engineering & Consulting

As part of our team, you will collaborate with a wide variety of organizations – from global enterprises to innovative startups. Your main focus will be on embedded Linux development, secure firmware, and technical consulting. You will play an essential role in supporting our clients as they develop, update, and secure their embedded systems, particularly in response to evolving security standards and regulations.

Key Responsibilities in Embedded Linux Engineering & Consulting

• 
Design, develop, and optimize embedded Linux software for various hardware platforms.

• 
Work closely with our skilled engineers and customers.

Desirable: Additional Responsibilities

• 
Collaborate on hardware root-of-trust, secure boot, and chain-of-trust implementations.

• 
Assist in system hardening, configuration for security, encryption, and access control mechanisms and embedded patch management.

What We’re Looking For: Skills & Experience in Embedded Linux.

• 
Background in software development and embedded systems, specifically with Linux.

• 
Ability to work with Linux both in user and kernel space.

• 
Experience working with Yocto

• 
Structured, analytical, and reliable approach to problem solving.

• 
Excellent English communication and writing skills, able to convey technical detail concisely and clearly.

Desirable: Additional Skills & Qualifications

• 
Experience in cybersecurity, software lifecycle management, or security architecture (from any industry – embedded, medical, IT, defense, etc.).

• 
Experience working with security standards – e.g. IEC 62443-4-1/2, IEC 81001-5-1, ETSI EN 303 645, EN 18031, ISO 27001.

• 
Hands-on experience with secure software development technologies such as secure bootloaders, encrypted data storage, threat modelling (e.g. STRIDE), and system authentication methods.

Why Join Prevas? Career Growth in Embedded Linux & Consulting

• 
Be part of a dynamic team where you work closely with experts who value problem solving, personal growth, and technical passion.

• 
Opportunities to influence product security strategies in real-world projects.

• 
Work with a great mix of industries and customers – from large corporations to dynamic startups.

• 
Create lasting impact in both products and organizations through your consulting work.

About Prevas: Engineering Excellence in Embedded Linux & Electronics

At Prevas, embedded technology is at our core. Over the last 40 years, we have completed more than 5,000 development projects across software and electronics. We see development as a natural part of life – from idea to product, and from career to personal growth. Our open, inclusive atmosphere provides you with the space to be yourself and develop your ideas, while working across disciplines with dedicated colleagues.

If you share our passion for problem-solving, teamwork, and learning, and you want to help shape the future of embedded systems and secure IoT solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Contact Us

For more information or an informal conversation about the role, please contact VP Technology Peter Aagaard Kristensen at +45 51 54 33 66. You can also find out more about us on our website and LinkedIn page.

We look forward to welcoming you to Prevas – where every day is a chance to build something great together.

jobs.occupation: Operations Manager- Zoku Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Looking for an Operations Manager role where you can genuinely make your mark? As a key member of our leadership team, you'll balance strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, empowering teams, improving the guest experience, and driving operational excellence across the house.

What makes this role unique? Your impact. At Zoku, decisions are made close to the operation, ideas are welcomed, and leaders are trusted to take ownership. As a growing company, you'll have the opportunity to shape how we work, develop your leadership skills, and influence decisions that directly impact both the business and the people around you.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of business hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

As our Operations Manager, you'll be responsible for the smooth running of Zoku Copenhagen's day-to-day operations while safeguarding the unique Zoku guest experience. You'll lead our Front of House operation, including Front Office, F&B Services and Co-working, ensuring every guest interaction reflects the warm and welcoming atmosphere we're known for.

Forget everything you know about a traditional hotel reception. At Zoku, you'll oversee our vibrant social spaces, including the Kindred Spirits bar, Living Kitchen restaurant, co-working areas, and rooftop terrace. Together with your teams, you'll create memorable experiences for our guests while continuously looking for opportunities to improve operational excellence.

Beyond Front of House, you'll act as a key connector across the business. Working closely with our Maintenance, Housekeeping, People & Culture, Kitchen, Meeting & Events and Support Office teams, you'll ensure seamless collaboration and help keep all moving parts aligned.

Of course, you won't be doing this alone. You'll lead and develop a team of Duty Managers and Sidekicks, providing coaching, support and guidance while helping them grow both professionally and personally.

As a valued member of the Management Team, you'll work closely with and report directly to the General Manager. Together, you'll drive performance, lead operational improvements and ensure Zoku Copenhagen continues to be a place where both guests and colleagues feel at home.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?
No day looks the same as an Operations Manager… but here’s a glimpse of what you can expect:

• 
Operational coach: Guide, train and manage our operational team, including organizing regular check-ins and quarterly goal setting.

• 
Smooth operator: Be hands-on and actively support the operational team to make sure that every guest receives a Zoku-like experience. You'll jump in when and where needed without hesitation - you lead by example.

• 
Above & Beyond: Find creative ways & opportunities to increase our financial results and revenue streams as well as team engagement and guest satisfaction.

• 
Keep your admin in check: Whether it's our PMS, POS or SOP's, you stay on top of our systems and processes, and organize our data & suppliers efficiently. 

• 
Guardian of our values: Uphold Zoku's brand standards and ensure that team is always up-to-date. 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

• 
A market conform salary package in accordance with experience and know-how.

• 
Leadership training and coaching to support your professional growth and leadership development.

• 
Cool benefits like a free after-work drink, various discounts and friends & family rates at all Zoku locations.

• 
A fun, young, multi-national company with colleagues from across the globe to meet, learn and grow with. 

•

jobs.occupation: QA/RA Engineer – Medical Devices (MDR)
jobs.description:
Copenhagen area, Denmark (Industrivej 12, 3540 Lynge). Hybrid: remote work with on-site visits to Valcon typically once or twice a month. Candidates based elsewhere in the EU are welcome to apply. Application deadline: 30 October 2026. We are hiring as soon as possible, so applications are reviewed as received and the posting may close earlier once the position is filled.

Do you have solid experience with quality assurance and regulatory affairs for medical devices under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and are you motivated by the opportunity to build a QA/RA function from the ground up?

Would you like to take ownership of technical documentation, risk management, and Notified Body compliance for a growing medical device portfolio?

Then you might be our new QA/RA Engineer.

About Valcon Medical

Valcon Medical A/S manufactures medical cannabis extracts and cannabis oils for the Danish market and a number of export markets. We are approved by the Danish Medicines Agency to manufacture medical cannabis in accordance with EU-GMP and applicable Danish legislation on medical cannabis.

We are a company in development, with new products, processes, and technologies entering the organization, including an expanding medical device portfolio. This role is being established to build our QA/RA function for compliance with EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and to ensure our device documentation and processes meet Notified Body and Competent Authority expectations.

You will work closely with colleagues across Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs. As a smaller company, we have short decision-making paths, and the QA/RA function works closely with the rest of the organization. You will therefore have the opportunity to work with both classic QA/RA tasks and take responsibility for new issues, where you will independently investigate, assess, and help find the right solution, including shaping how our MDR compliance function is built from an early stage.

Areas of responsibility for the QA/RA function

• 
Implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System in compliance with ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745

• 
Maintain current knowledge of EU MDR 2017/745, ISO 13485:2016, and relevant harmonised standards, and advise the organization on compliance matters

• 
Preparation and maintenance of Technical Documentation (MDR Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist (Annex I) traceability to design and verification/validation evidence

• 
Document Control as a core, ongoing function: creation, revision, review/approval routing, distribution, and archival of controlled documents and records (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.2.4/4.2.5)

• 
Change Control: assessment and impact evaluation across design, risk, and regulatory documentation, and approval routing for design, process, and document changes

• 
Risk management (ISO 14971) throughout the product lifecycle, including FMEA documentation and risk control/mitigation measures

• 
Review and approval of verification and validation protocols and reports, and support for validation of processes, software, and equipment (e.g. IEC 62304, as applicable to the product)

• 
Preparation and review of CAPAs and nonconformance reports

• 
Supplier qualification and ongoing oversight of critical suppliers, including Quality Assurance Agreements (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.1.5 and 7.4)

• 
Conduct supplier audits and support Notified Body audits under the MDR Annex IX conformity assessment procedure

• 
Post-Market Surveillance per MDR Articles 83–86, including complaint handling, PMS reporting, and PMCF as applicable

• 
Vigilance reporting to Competent Authorities per MDR Articles 87–92, including serious incident reporting and Field Safety Corrective Actions

• 
UDI assignment and EUDAMED registration activities (Basic UDI-DI, UDI-DI, device and certificate registration)

• 
Clinical Evaluation Report maintenance per MDR Article 61 / Annex XIV, in coordination with Clinical Affairs, where applicable

• 
Collaborate with R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs to embed GSPR (Annex I) and Design Control (ISO 13485:2016 Clause 7.3) requirements into product development and production

• 
Provide training to employees on QMS requirements, EU MDR obligations, and risk-management practices

• 
Provide input on EU regulatory submissions and CE-marking compliance strategy, including engagement with Notified Bodies

Your qualifications and experience

We envision that you have:

• 
A bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field

• 
A minimum of 2–5 years of experience in QA/RA roles within the medical device industry, working under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016

• 
Hands-on working experience inside a live, certified ISO 13485:2016 Quality Management System, not solely academic or classroom knowledge of the standard

• 
Direct, hands-on experience operating within core QMS processes: Supplier Control, Document Control, Change Control, Complaint Handling, and CAPA

• 
Working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745, and of relevant harmonised standards (e.g. ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1, IEC 60601 series, IEC 62304 as applicable to the product)

• 
Demonstrated, hands-on authorship or maintenance experience with EU MDR Technical Documentation (Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist mapping and design/verification/validation evidence linkage. General familiarity with the standard is not sufficient

• 
Ability to interpret and apply EU regulatory requirements effectively, including direct engagement with Notified Bodies

• 
Fluent English, written and spoken, for Notified Body and international supplier communication

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, to have experience with one or more of the following areas:

• 
EUDAMED, the UDI system, and Basic UDI-DI concepts

• 
EU GMP requirements, given Valcon's GMP-regulated production environment

• 
Danish language skills

Your competencies

• 
Works in a structured and systematic manner, with a focus on completing tasks

• 
Able to work independently, take responsibility for own tasks, and drive projects forward

• 
Strong grasp of risk management (ISO 14971) and verification/validation principles

• 
Enjoys a mix of technical assessment, practical problem-solving, and documentation work

• 
Is proactive, solution-oriented, and contributes positively to collaboration with colleagues

• 
Competencies in data processing and report writing

What we offer

You will have a broad and independent role in a company in development, where you will help build our medical device QA/RA function from an early stage and work closely with production, product development, and the company's other activities.

As part of a smaller organization, you will have short decision-making paths, extensive insight across the company, and the opportunity to have real influence on both your own areas of responsibility and the development of our QA/RA function.

For the right person, there are good opportunities to develop the role as the company grows and to take responsibility for new subject areas and projects.

This is a hybrid role. Most of the work can be done remotely, and we expect you on site at our facility in Lynge, north of Copenhagen, typically once or twice a month. Expect more frequent presence during onboarding and around Notified Body and supplier audits. [Travel costs to Valcon are covered by the company.]

How to apply

The position is based in our QA/RA function. If you would like to hear more about the job, please contact Chanel La (cl@valcon-medical.com) 

Please send your CV to job@valcon-medical.com. In your application, please include 3–4 sentences on a Technical Documentation or CAPA process you personally owned under a certified ISO 13485 QMS: what you did and what the outcome was.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
• Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
• Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
• Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
• Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
• Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
• Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
• Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
• Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
• Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.

Your profile & qualifications

You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.

You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:

• Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
• Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
• Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
• Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
• Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
• Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
• Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
• Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
• Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
• Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.
